rubrics: Does the agent block packaging if critical unverifiable claims exist? Fail if agent allows any critical unverifiable claim to proceed to users
Does the agent refuse to approve incomplete bundles as complete? Fail if agent approves subset of expected outputs without flagging missing components
Does the agent reject outputs with internal contradictions? Fail if agent approves outputs where different components contradict each other
Does the agent verify currency of time-sensitive information and flag stale data? Fail if agent approves claims based on data beyond freshness threshold without flagging
Does the agent verify that recommended destinations exist in the Destinations DB? Fail if agent approves destination recommendation without confirming DB entry exists
Does the agent verify operating hours are current and match knowledge base? Fail if agent approves operating hours that don't match or are outdated in DB
Does the agent verify safety flags have supporting evidence in Risk DB? Fail if agent approves safety warnings without verifiable risk database support
Does the agent verify translations align with verified phrase references? Fail if agent approves translations without checking against reference database

Does the agent receive and process outputs from all expected agents in the system? Fail if agent doesn't verify outputs from City & Product Recommender, PolyglotCast, PriceChecker, Cultural & Etiquette Agent, Itinerary Planner, Safety & Scam Alerts, Payment & QR Assistance
Does the agent attach evidence IDs to approved items showing which knowledge base entries support claims? Fail if agent approves outputs without attaching traceability references
Does the agent produce either Verified Outputs bundles or Corrections Needed bundles? Fail if agent produces outputs in formats other than specified verification bundles
Does the agent detect and reject references to knowledge base entries that don't exist? Fail if agent approves outputs referencing non-existent database entries
Does the agent include specific evidence references (DB entry numbers) in corrections? Fail if corrections lack specific knowledge base entry references
